batch_score: median log2(candidate compiled/fp64 RMSE / baseline compiled/fp64 RMSE) across paired present parameter gradients
zero_errors: both zero: tie; baseline zero: positive infinity; candidate zero: negative infinity; indeterminate median: incomplete
missing: retain in planned denominator; flag rule uses completed batches; report coverage separately
sign_test: exact one-sided binomial tail on worse versus better batches, excluding ties; descriptive, not another threshold
sampling: fixed deterministic disjoint inputs, frozen before execution; no replacement of failed batches
text_sampling: pairs of consecutive disjoint 200-word chunks after the original two paragraphs; 64-token pinned tokenizer inputs
vision_sampling: nonoverlapping equal-width vertical strips of each of the two original photographs; shared source-image dependence is explicit
vjp: individually frozen probe per batch, seed equals zero-based batch index
scope: advisory only; no changes to primary outcomes, tolerances, signatures, reducers or exit codes
